first_visual_findings: continuous wood lower apron visible and structurally stronger than R07

discrepancies.reference_observation: Thick layered puffy snow cap with irregular scalloped front edge and substantial overhang, gently mounded around chimney
discrepancies.baseline_mismatch: R07 roof is comparatively smooth, conical and sheetlike; lacks heavy drape and scallops
discrepancies.R22_change: Watertight 64-point radial scalloped overhang, asymmetrical mounds and thicker drooping perimeter. First pass exposed real overhang but roof remains visually unapproved.

discrepancies.reference_observation: Wide deep recessed stamped silver arch with actual dark glass opening and internally visible saw, plus distinct corner fasteners
discrepancies.baseline_mismatch: Flattened/mechanically simple silver arch and inadequate depth illusion
discrepancies.R22_change: First real hollow bezel visibly exposed incomplete lower sill; source now includes new continuous stamped steel bottom bar, retest pending. No visual acceptance.

discrepancies.reference_observation: Integrated weight-bearing timber platform, thick lower aprons and steel-protected posts without broad open daylight
discrepancies.baseline_mismatch: Open four-leg table frame with sparse wood beams
discrepancies.R22_change: Continuous lower front/rear and side wooden aprons; original footprint unchanged. First pass shows a more continuous base but still lacks reference timber grain/steel framing.

discrepancies.reference_observation: Full irregular marbled raw-meat pieces in wooden bin; cooked tray holds varied strapped beige and red wrapped food
discrepancies.baseline_mismatch: R07 food is smooth simplified lumps and trays show simplistic repeating blocks
discrepancies.R22_change: Not yet changed; subsequent geometry milestone

discrepancies.reference_observation: Prominent volumetric billowing warm-white smoke from open steel chimney
discrepancies.baseline_mismatch: Static cooker GLB has chimney geometry but no smoke VFX
discrepancies.R22_change: Not baked into GLB; runtime camera-matched particle or volumetric effect pending

discrepancies.reference_observation: Painterly irregular snow, brushed light-metal, grainy chunky wood, red marbled meat and orange bands

release_policy: Technical GLB and Blender views are not authority to promote R22. Require source-bound independent exact-reference visual pass, in-game native and physical Android, user and integration owner approval. Keep T05 and global pipeline PRs draft.
